purpose: Teach: せり/右下/団員/シャフト/本拠地/在り/ハイライト/ロケーション

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、市場の、本気で、絶対、せり、絶対、参加して、絶対、新鮮な、絶対、食材、絶対、仕入れよか
lines.en: Aoi, you've got to go to the market auctions — seriously, I mean it. That's how you get the freshest ingredients.
lines.style: Enthusiastic, warm, Kansai cadence. Leans forward with genuine excitement. Repeating emphasis without condescension — he's inviting her into something he cares about.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。メニューの、本気で、絶対、右下に、絶対、アレルギー情報、絶対、書きましょう、葵で
lines.en: Right. And we should put allergy information clearly on the menu — bottom right, where people look.
lines.style: Practical, thoughtful. Speaking as an equal, not just responding. Genuine consideration for customers woven into her tone. Quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 地域のイベントの、本気で、絶対、団員、絶対、葵で、絶対、お招きしよか
lines.en: You know, there's a community event coming up. I'd really like it if you'd come along, helped us out with the group.
lines.style: Open and warm, Kansai lilt. Not demanding — inviting her into something bigger. Genuine affection underneath the enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。新しいミキサーの、本気で、絶対、シャフト、絶対、強化版に、絶対、変えませんか
lines.en: Of course. And about the new mixer — we should upgrade to the stronger shaft model. That'll make a real difference.
lines.style: Measured, practical. She's thinking this through. Not just agreeing — she's engaged, building on his ideas with her own. Calm certainty.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、本気で、絶対、本拠地として、絶対、この街、絶対、根付いていきたいで
lines.en: Aoi, I want this town to feel like home base for me. I want to really put down roots here.
lines.style: Quiet intensity underneath. Kansai warmth, but serious now. He's being vulnerable — telling her something that matters. Direct eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。お客様の、本気で、絶対、在りし日の、絶対、思い出、絶対、語ってくださる時、絶対、嬉しいですね
lines.en: I love when customers come in and tell stories about the way things used to be. Those moments really stay with me.
lines.style: Warm, genuinely listening. A slight smile in the voice. She's noticing what he's noticing — the real value of what they're building. Soft and present.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵で、本気で、絶対、ハイライト、絶対、料理、絶対、お客さん、絶対、感動するで
lines.en: That's what gets to me most, Aoi — when the food we make really moves someone. That's the highlight for me.
lines.style: Genuine emotion breaking through. Kansai warmth and directness. Not overstated — just honest about what matters to him. Slight breathiness on the key words.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。新店舗の、本気で、絶対、ロケーション、絶対、慎重に、絶対、選びましょう
lines.en: Absolutely. We should take our time choosing the location for the new place. This matters too much to rush.
lines.style: Steady, warm, grounded. She's thinking long-term alongside him. Quiet wisdom — not cautious, but careful. A slight closing warmth, like she's saying 'I'm with you on this.'
